content.text:
当你将一个变量或方法声明为**static**(静态)时，它属于这个类，而不是一个特定的实例对象。

**static**变量是同一个类中所有对象共享的。

When you declare a variable or a method as static, it belongs to the class, rather than to a specific instance. This means that only one instance of a **static **member exists, even if you create multiple objects of the class, or if you don't create any. It will be shared by all objects. Example:

content.text_html:
The **COUNT **variable will be shared by all objects of that class. Now, we can create objects of our Counter class in main, and access the static variable.

content.text: 在给静态变量命名时，使用大写字母是一种常见的做法，尽管不是必须的。
content.text_html:
It’s a common practice to use upper case when naming a static variable, although not mandatory.

在给静态变量命名时，使用大写字母是一种常见的做法，尽管不是必须的。
